No options on issue. Funding dilution is NOT put through the share count: it is charged as a US$ dilution cost in each scenario's equity bridge, so the count stays flat.
inputs.net_debt_note: Cash US$58.84m at 30-Jun-2026, no borrowings (lease liabilities ~US$0.3m ignored). The US$996m DOE facility is closed but undrawn; first advance is gated on conditions precedent.
inputs.last_fcf_note: Trailing twelve months to 30-Jun-2026 (6-month transition period to Dec-2025 plus H1 to Jun-2026): OCF -6.756, capitalised project spend -11.209. Not a base for projection; it is the pre-FID burn rate.
inputs.sbc_source: Cash-flow statement add-back: US$1.102m (6 months to Dec-2025) + US$0.846m (6 months to Jun-2026)
inputs.fx_note: AUDUSD 0.6774 (Yahoo AUDUSD=X, 13-Nov-2026), so 1 USD = 1.4762 AUD. Parity check against the Nasdaq ADS (IONR, 1 ADS = 40 ordinary shares, ratio from memory of the listing terms): the ASX close converts to about US$2.33 per ADS against a US$2.18 ADS close later the same day, a 6% gap that is timing plus thin ADS liquidity, not a ratio error.
inputs.fiscal_year_end: 31 December (changed from 30 June; FY2026 annual is a six-month transition period to 31-Dec-2025)

project_anchors.provenance: NPV, IRR, AISC, mine life, reserve and the DOE facility are from the filings and kpis table. The filings state the NPV is unlevered and after tax but not its discount rate, the capex total or the price deck. The 8% rate, the US$1,668m Class 2 capex estimate (+US$15m for the leach change, which IS in the filing), the US$968m principal within the US$996m facility and ~21,000 tpa LCE are recalled from the company's 2025 project announcements, not read from the extracted text; verify against the S-K 1300 report. The steady-state FCF is solved so the model reproduces the disclosed NPV; the model IRR then lands near the disclosed 18.0%, which is the cross-check that the capex and timing shape are about right.

inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD rate. US 10-year Treasury ~4.3% plus a 5% equity risk premium on an unlevered asset beta of ~1.1-1.2 gives ~10% for base, 9% for bull; the study's 8% is a project convention, not a required return. The rate carries market and operating risk only. Financing and permitting risk are charged in the scenario weights, construction risk in the capex overrun and ramp, lithium price in the deck, and the cheap DOE debt is valued separately as a subsidy (adjusted present value) instead of by lowering the rate.

risk_charging_map.permit_appeal: scenario weights and base-case FID timing
risk_charging_map.dilution: new-money discount in the equity bridge

inputs.nci_treatment: None today. A project-level partner would create one; it is handled economically through the new-money discount, which is indifferent to whether new capital enters at the project or the listed-company level.
inputs.notes: MODEL: risked project NPV, not owner-FCF. ioneer has no revenue and no free cash flow, so there is nothing for the component engine to project; dcf-methods SKILL.md has no routing row for a pre-revenue single-asset developer, and this follows the SMI.NZ precedent (project NPV weighted on the financing binary, plus cash, less the cost of funding the gap). This JSON is written directly, not by build-dcf. Per-share value in the two proceed cases = (project NPV at FID at the scenario rate + DOE loan subsidy + corporate cash at FID - overhead - dilution cost) discounted to today, over today's fully diluted shares. Dilution cost = new money required x d/(1-d), where d is the discount to intrinsic value at which new capital enters; this is the closed form of issuing at (1-d) x post-money value and avoids guessing a raise price. STALE-EVIDENCE WARNING: the newest filing in the folder is the half-year to 30-Jun-2026. The partner process was targeted to close by end-September 2026 and FID in 2H-2026; no announcement after the half-year report was available to this build. The share price has since fallen to its 52-week low, which is consistent with that deadline passing without a binding agreement, and the base case assumes exactly that (FID late 2027). If a binding partner agreement or a failed process has been announced, the weights are wrong and should be redone. House and street values coincide (SBC ~US$2m a year is inside the overhead line), so band_position is null.

historical_growth.notes: Pre-revenue developer: no revenue or positive FCF in any of 18 periods, EPS negative throughout. Equity grew only by issuance (shares 1,469m in FY2018 to 3,075m). The series also changes currency (AUD to USD at FY2023) and year-end (June to December). All CAGRs deliberately null.

base.scenario: FID reached late 2027, after the Ninth Circuit ruling: partner(s) and public equity fund the gap at a 30% discount to intrinsic value; LCE US$20,000/t; capex 10% over the Class 2 estimate; first production 2030-31, a year-plus behind guidance
base.terminal_note: Finite 77-year mine life in closed form; no terminal value. At 9-10% the years beyond 40 are under 3% of operating PV.

bull.scenario: FID mid-2027 with a strategic or government-backed partner entering near intrinsic value (15% discount); LCE US$25,000/t, close to the study-implied deck; capex on estimate; first production 2030
bull.terminal_note: Finite 77-year mine life in closed form; no terminal value. At 9-10% the years beyond 40 are under 3% of operating PV.

bear.scenario: No FID inside three years: partner process fails or keeps slipping, DOE conditions precedent stay unmet, company survives on small raises
bear.components_note: 25% of the US$214.7m capitalised exploration and evaluation asset (a permitted, engineered, DOE-approved deposit keeps option value even unfunded) plus 30-Jun-2026 cash less three years of reduced holding costs. Not zero, and not discounted.

projections.note: Closed-form project model, US$m, years counted from FID. Construction years 1-3 take 30/45/25% of capex; production year 1 runs at 50%, year 2 at 85%, then steady state for the rest of a 77-year life.

bear.note: No project cash flows; asset and cash residual only.

entry_price.method_note: No terminal value, so the standard TV-at-hurdle formula does not apply. Each scenario value already compounds at its own rate; the price that clears 15% a year to first production (years to FID plus a three-year build) is IV x ((1+r)/1.15)^n. Bear uses three years at 10%.

required_return_table.note: Base scenario, AUD per share, at alternative unlevered discount rates; funding structure held constant. Not weighted for financing risk.

sensitivity.axes_note: Rows = long-run lithium price (US$/t LCE), columns = unlevered discount rate (%). Base-scenario structure, AUD per share, NOT weighted for financing risk. Terminal growth does not exist in this model; lithium price replaces it. Cells are floored at zero (limited liability): a zero means the project cannot be financed on those terms without wiping out existing holders, and the realistic outcome there is the bear case.

new_money_discount_grid.axes_note: Rows = LCE price, columns = discount to intrinsic value at which new money enters. Base rate 10%.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Framed on the financing binary, not on growth. FID inside about two years: 45% (base 35 + bull 10). For it: the DOE loan is closed, the permits survived district court, boron and lithium are on the US critical-minerals list, and Korean state-linked counterparties have signed MOUs. Against it: the partner search has run since Sibanye-Stillwater left in February 2025 and has missed every self-imposed date; the MOUs are non-binding; the company is worth under US$200m against roughly US$1bn of equity the project still needs; and the Ninth Circuit will not rule before mid-2027, which a new partner may well wait for. Bull is held at 10% because it needs both a strong lithium price and a partner who pays close to intrinsic value. Bear is 55% and is not a wipe-out: a permitted, engineered deposit keeps option value.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street bases coincide; the band collapsed.
probability_weighted.market_implied_note: Holding the base:bull mix at 35:10, the current price is what the model returns at this probability of reaching FID, against the 45% used here.

scenario_narratives.base: A partner or partners sign after the Ninth Circuit rules, FID lands in late 2027 and production starts 2030-31. At US$20,000/t LCE and 10% the project is worth about US$400m at FID and the DOE loan adds about US$232m, but roughly US$1050m of new money has to come in at a 30% discount, and that costs existing holders about US$450m. What is left for existing holders is about US$167m today, roughly the current market value: success on ordinary terms is already in the price.
scenario_narratives.bull: A strategic or government-backed investor enters near intrinsic value in the first half of 2027, lithium sits at US$25,000/t and the build comes in on estimate. Project NPV at FID is about US$1526m at 9%, and the dilution cost drops to about US$145m. Nearly all of the weighted value sits here.
scenario_narratives.bear: No binding partner, no DOE draw, no FID inside three years. The company keeps the permits alive on small raises. Value is a quarter of the capitalised project spend plus cash less holding costs.

valuation_philosophy.approach: Risked project NPV for a pre-revenue, single-asset lithium-boron developer
valuation_philosophy.summary: ioneer is a claim on one unbuilt mine. The study's US$2.23bn is an 8% NPV of the whole project before anyone pays for it; the listed equity is worth that figure re-discounted at a required return, at a lithium price below the study's, less the cost of bringing in about US$1bn of new equity through a company worth under US$200m. Done that way, the equity is worth about today's price in the ordinary success case, well under half of it if the project stalls, and several times the price only if lithium and the partner terms are both good. The stock is an option on that combination, and the weighted value should be read as such, not as a central estimate.
key_risks_to_valuation: The discount at which new money enters is the largest single lever: at US$20,000/t every 10 points of discount is worth more than the whole base-case equity value
Lithium price: the model's implied study deck is about US$26503/t; base runs at 20,000 and the project NPV at 10% turns negative a little below that
Calibration inputs not found in the extracted filings (8% study rate, capex total, LCE tonnage) are recalled, not sourced; a 10% error in tonnage moves steady-state cash flow 10%
No evidence after 30-Jun-2026 was available; the partner-process outcome since the end-September target is unknown to this model
Ninth Circuit ruling expected mid-2027; an adverse ruling is inside the 55% bear weight, not modelled separately
DOE loan terms or availability could change with US policy; the subsidy is worth roughly US$230-315m in the proceed cases
